full_text: The World Map allows you to traverse Colorado in your trusty Kodiak. As you explore, you'll find cities and settlements in need of your help, as well as experience Random Encounters that may bring fortune, trade, danger, or all three at once.

text: You've got a tip on a new location. When you hear about a new place to explore, it'll be marked on y
full_text: You've got a tip on a new location. When you hear about a new place to explore, it'll be marked on your Map Screen with a star. It's up to you to find a safe path there.

text: Watch out! That glowing green cloud ahead is radiation. Radiation can damage your squad, make them s
full_text: Watch out! That glowing green cloud ahead is radiation. Radiation can damage your squad, make them sick, give them mutations, and even kill them. The severity level of a radiation hazard is shown on the Geiger Counter at the top of the screen. To navigate the fallout, find and install upgrades to the Kodiak to boost its Radiation Resistance.

text: Wow, what was that? Some objects in the world are hidden. Each character in your squad has a Percept
full_text: Wow, what was that? Some objects in the world are hidden. Each character in your squad has a Perception stat that indicates how well they're able to spot hidden objects like alarms, traps, or secrets.

text: You've recruited your first Companion! Companions are a unique kind of squad member. Unlike the Rang
full_text: You've recruited your first Companion! Companions are a unique kind of squad member. Unlike the Rangers you create, Companions are pre-made characters that have their own personality and agenda. Piss them off and they could leave you high and dry.

text: You can have up to six characters in your squad. Up to four of them can be Ranger recruits, leaving
full_text: You can have up to six characters in your squad. Up to four of them can be Ranger recruits, leaving at least two spots open for Companions. There's no reason not to take them along, provided you can maintain their loyalty.

text: Companions have a chance of Going Rogue. When they do, they'll sometimes perform special abilities,
full_text: Companions have a chance of Going Rogue. When they do, they'll sometimes perform special abilities, and other times they'll just fuck everything up. The higher your squad's average Charisma, the better chance you have of your companions performing a positive action instead of a negative one.

text: That enemy has Armor, which means that it can block some of your incoming damage! Fortunately, all w
full_text: That enemy has Armor, which means that it can block some of your incoming damage! Fortunately, all weapons have a Penetration stat. If your weapon's Penetration is equal to or greater than your enemy's Armor, your weapon will deal full damage.

text: Energy, Fire, Cold, and Explosion Damage
full_text: Energy, Fire, Cold, and Explosion Damage

text: Elemental Weapons ignore enemy Armor entirely. The four elemental damage types are Energy, Fire, Col
full_text: Elemental Weapons ignore enemy Armor entirely. The four elemental damage types are Energy, Fire, Cold, and Explosive damage. Enemies are often weak to some elemental damage types and resistant to others.

text: When you've been spotted by an enemy, each Ranger in your squad has a chance to take the first comba
full_text: When you've been spotted by an enemy, each Ranger in your squad has a chance to take the first combat turn, with a higher Initiative stat increasing that chance. To get a higher Initiative, you can increase your Speed attribute and Sneaky Shit skill.

text: Need some explosives, medical supplies, or a pet killer robot? Crafting has you covered! To craft ad
full_text: Need some explosives, medical supplies, or a pet killer robot? Crafting has you covered! To craft advanced items, someone in your squad needs to have the Crafting skill. Some specialized equipment may also need additional Skills to craft, such as First Aid, Weird Science, Weapon Modding, or Armor Modding.

text: You discovered a Crafting Recipe! Crafting Recipes don't appear in your Inventory Screen. Instead, t
full_text: You discovered a Crafting Recipe! Crafting Recipes don't appear in your Inventory Screen. Instead, they're automatically added to your Crafting Screen and can be accessed from it.

text: In the wasteland, you'll find both Weapon and Armor Mods. Installing a Mod will improve any equipmen
full_text: In the wasteland, you'll find both Weapon and Armor Mods. Installing a Mod will improve any equipment it's attached to, but once installed, they cannot be removed. To install a Mod, one of your squad members must have the necessary Weapon Modding or Armor Modding Skill Level.

text: To install a Weapon or Armor Mod, select the weapon or armor you want to upgrade and choose the Modi
full_text: To install a Weapon or Armor Mod, select the weapon or armor you want to upgrade and choose the Modify option under it. Different Mods require different Armor or Weapon Modding Skill Levels. The better the Mod, the harder it is to install.

text: You've unlocked the Medbay! Here you can shop for medical supplies. You can also speak to the Doctor
full_text: You've unlocked the Medbay! Here you can shop for medical supplies. You can also speak to the Doctor to get free health care, including restoring any Incapacitated squad members.

text: You've unlocked the Armory! You can come here to shop for new weapons and armor at a discounted rate
full_text: You've unlocked the Armory! You can come here to shop for new weapons and armor at a discounted rate!

text: You've unlocked Ananda the tailor! With his services, you will be able to purchase clothing items to
full_text: You've unlocked Ananda the tailor! With his services, you will be able to purchase clothing items to keep your squad at the height of post-apocalyptic fashion. Ananda also sells trinkets and other assorted goods.

text: You're now able to customize your Ranger Insignia! Talk to Sgt. Greatski to select your own logo to
full_text: You're now able to customize your Ranger Insignia! Talk to Sgt. Greatski to select your own logo to represent the Rangers in Colorado.

text: Speak to Sgt. Greatski to hire new Rangers for your squad. Your squad can have up to six members. No
full_text: Speak to Sgt. Greatski to hire new Rangers for your squad. Your squad can have up to six members. No more than four can be Rangers. The other two slots may be filled by Companions, such as Marshal Kwon. Companions are unique NPCs who aren't officially Rangers, but want to help out all the same. You'll find plenty of Companions on your journey throughout Colorado.

text: You've unlocked your Garage! From here you can customize the Kodiak to improve its stats, weaponry,
full_text: You've unlocked your Garage! From here you can customize the Kodiak to improve its stats, weaponry, abilities, and more. You can also customize its appearance, so you can ride through the wasteland in style. As you explore, you'll discover and unlock new vehicle upgrades.

full_text: One of your Rangers has been Downed! Rangers are Downed when they reach 0 CON. They'll stay Downed for several turns before becoming Incapacitated. If another character can reach them before that happens, they can spend some of their Action Points (AP) to revive them.

text: Oh shit! One of your Rangers has been Incapacitated. They aren't dead, but they won't be able to con
full_text: Oh shit! One of your Rangers has been Incapacitated. They aren't dead, but they won't be able to contribute to your squad while in that state. To resuscitate them, you can find a Doctor NPC and have them provide treatment. If you've got a Nitro Spike item handy, you can also use it to restore all Incapacitated Rangers in your squad.

full_text: Now that you've got a full squad, you might want to kick someone out to make room for fresh blood. Talk to Sgt. Greatski to manage your squad and recruit new Rangers.
